item.title: 6 Things to Know About Tucker Wetmore, the 2026 ACM Winner for New Male Artist of the Year
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and updates from the world of country music. I'm your host, and today we're talking about the Academy of Country Music Awards' new male artist of the year, Tucker Wetmore.
[Music transitions to a country-inspired tune]
Host: "This 26-year-old singer from Washington state is making waves in the music industry, and it's no surprise why. Wetmore was recently performing in London when he received the news that he's this year's recipient of the award. But what makes this moment even more special is how he found out.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "Wetmore's mom, Sia, walked on stage and directed everyone's attention to the video screens, where Thomas Rhett announced the news. Wetmore was visibly moved, saying, 'I'm at a loss for words right now... I couldn't do any of this without my team, my family, and every single person who's supported me along the way.'
[Music transitions to a more upbeat tune]
Host: "This isn't Wetmore's first time working with Thomas Rhett, by the way. Last summer, he was the opening act for Rhett's tour. And if history is any indication, Wetmore is on the right path. Seven past winners of this award have gone on to win the ACM's entertainer of the year prize, including big names like Merle Haggard, Kenny Chesney, and Luke Bryan.
[Music fades out]
Host: "We're excited to see where Wetmore's career takes him from here. Congratulations to Tucker Wetmore on this well-deserved award, and we can't wait to see him perform at the 61st annual ACM Awards on May 17. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast, and we'll catch you in the next one!"
[Outro music plays]
